803-3277-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-3277-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4863-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4863-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2393-4279-5332--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-5332--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1981-2403-2415-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6458-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1981-2415-6458-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4094-4365-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.

116-950-7786.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
If Kiora's Follower has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
If Fatestitcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-3680.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-3680.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Stunt Double and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-3680.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2292-4681-6542-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

6097-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6097-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7606.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, it's innate ability and persist ability each trigger.
Resolve the trigger from Rampant Rejuvenator's innate ability, allowing you to search your library for a number of basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Rampant Rejuvenator from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with six +1/+1 counters on it

4316-5078-7444.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2086-3967-6996.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
1115-3259-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

Repeat.

1778-2034-4053-6989.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {R}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Repeat

74-969-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

2457-3129-4289-4927.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2-5637-6441.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2511-3476-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2525-6132.description:
Cast Metamorphosis Fanatic by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Body Double, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5147-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2645-5709.notablePrerequisites: Rofellos does not have summoning sickness. You control at least five Forests.
2645-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Rofellos.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-5709.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

413-2018-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-2018-2946-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Cult Conscript from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Cult Conscript enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from steps 1 and 6, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

779-4970-4985-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

955-1232-1270-5477.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

730-880-3470.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Emeria Angel trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

360-1274-3197.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-1274-3197.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

355-3259.easyPrerequisites: Another Human has entered under your control this turn.
355-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
355-3259.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Éowyn triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
355-3259.notes: As the loop makes an extra creature token, you'll eventually begin to start drawing cards as well.

934-2290-4384.notablePrerequisites:
Amorphous Axe attached to Spike Feeder.
Spike Feeder has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
934-2290-4384.description:
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Treebeard triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Repeat.
Once Spike Feeder has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may target any other Halfling or Treefolk with Treebeard's ability.

800-4893-4949.notablePrerequisites: Knacksaw Clique does not have summoning sickness.
800-4893-4949.description:
Activate Knacksaw Clique by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Knacksaw Clique by paying {U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to cast that card this turn.
Repeat.

914-1309-3130-3584.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
You have cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
914-1309-3130-3584.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, creating at least one copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, targeting Dockside Extortionist and any other creature(s) as applicable.
Resolve the first copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Resolve all remaining copies of Blue Sun's Twilight, as applicable.
Resolve the original Blue Sun's Twilight from step 1, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
The Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, returning Blue Sun's Twilight from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target Salvager of Secrets and any other creature to get infinite copies of any creature on the battlefield.

1368-2397-3538-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three cards in your graveyard.
1368-2397-3538-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gnawing Vermin, adding {B}.
Gnawing Vermin dies, triggering its second ability, causing target creature you don't control to get -1/-1 until end of turn.
Cast Gnawing Vermin from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Gnawing Vermin enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability twice, causing you to mill four cards.
Repeat.

261-654-3344-3499-4013.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
261-654-3344-3499-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Rasputin.
Rasputin enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Amulet of Vigor, and Suture Priest's first ability.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor ability, untapping Rasputin.
Resolve the Rasputin trigger, putting at least three dream counters on itself and causing each opponent to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token.
The Goblins enter the battlefield, triggering Suture Priest's second ability three times.
Holding priority, activate Rasputin's first ability by tapping it and removing three dream counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Resolve all Suture Priest triggers, causing each opponent to lose infinite life.

215-851-4231-4634.description:
Cast Wavesifter for its evoke cost by paying {G}{U}.
Wavesifter enters the battlefield, triggering itself and its evoke ability.
Resolve the first Wavesifter trigger, creating four Clue, four Treasure, and four Food tokens.
Activate the four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wavesifter from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Wavesifter trigger from step 2, failing to sacrifice Wavesifter due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat.

1447-1734-4050.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1090-1409-4344.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Lumbering Battlement.
1090-1409-4344.description:
Activate Lumbering Battlement by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield.
Restoration Angel and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering Restoration Angel's ability, Lumbering Battlement's ability, and Deadeye Navigator's ability twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, choosing not to pair.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.
